notes: Fibre Channel characterization centers on the FC-0 SerDes (eye/jitter at the GFC rate), FC-1 encoding (8b/10b / 64b/66b, word sync), FC-2 framing/CRC/credit, and the login protocol. Conformance follows the INCITS T11 standards (FC-FS framing/signaling, FC-LS link services, FC-SW switch fabric, FC-GS generic services, FCP).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Serial eye / jitter at the target GFC rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: FC-0 transmitter/receiver compliance at 1/2/4/8/16/32/64 GFC (NRZ, PAM-4 at 64GFC).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Receiver CDR lock / word synchronization
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify embedded-clock recovery and K28.5 comma alignment.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Link initialization
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Primitive-sequence protocol (NOS/OLS/LR/LRR) and IDLE exchange to ACTIVE.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: 32-bit CRC
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject errors and confirm frame discard + sequence recovery (ABTS).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Credit flow control
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: BB_Credit (R_RDY) and EE_Credit (ACK) accounting, including long-distance BB_Credit.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Login + addressing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: FLOGI 24-bit-address assignment, PLOGI/PRLI parameter negotiation, WWN exchange.
